resources.string: Auto-taps “Skip ad” on every YouTube app
Automatically taps the “Skip ad” button in YouTube, YouTube Music, YouTube Go, Kids, Vanced, ReVanced and web browsers when it appears. The app does not collect or send any data.
Skip Ad Pro is watching YouTube for you
Turn on “Skip Ad Pro” in Accessibility to start
Turn off to pause without removing the service
Chrome, Firefox, Brave, Edge, Samsung, Coc Coc…
Small message after each successful skip

• YouTube, YouTube Music, YouTube Go, YouTube Kids, YouTube TV
• YouTube Vanced / ReVanced (including Music)
• Browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Brave, Edge, Opera, Samsung, Vivaldi, Coc Coc…
• Detects the skip button in many languages (EN, VI, ES, FR, DE, JA, KO, ZH, RU…)

1. Tap “Open Accessibility settings” → Downloaded apps → Skip Ad Pro → turn on.
2. Android 13+: if the switch is greyed out, go to Settings → Apps → Skip Ad Pro → ⋮ (top right) → “Allow restricted settings”, then repeat step 1.
3. Open YouTube. When the Skip button shows up, the app taps it for you.

Note: only skippable ads can be skipped. Non-skippable ads must still play through.
